text:
nina: quick q about deprecation windows for model versions — we're planning to unpin default model v1 in favor of v2. what's the minimum notice we need for client SDKs and internal services?

sam: suggest 60 days for public notice + 30 day grace where both versions served. internal teams might need less but better to standardize.

priya: do we have telemetry to know how many calls are explicitly pinning 'model=v1' vs relying on default? would change the risk calc.

marc: yes — console has a per-model metric. i'll pull counts today. overall rule of thumb: if >5% of traffic pins v1, we should extend.

nina: ok, that's helpful. two follow ups: (1) what header do we use for pinning in the contract (reminder for docs/SDK) and (2) what compatibility signals should we emit to callers before cut?

sam: header is X-Model-Version in the API — already in public spec. for warnings we can use a 299 Informational header and an event in usage logs. example: `X-Deprecation-Warning: v1 will be retired 2026-06-15`

priya: +1 on header warning. also recommend an early opt-in canary: route 1% of unpinned traffic to v2 for 2w and run diff checks on outputs for our eval set.

marc: can we automate the canary in the rollout service? it needs to respect Dedicated tenants pinned to v1.

sam: yes — rollout flags support 'only-unpinned' routing. i'll add a canary config: `canary{pct:1, duration:14d, metrics:[latency, perplexity, eval-regressions]}`

nina: nice. about grace period length: i hear 60+30 from sam, but priya asked for automated client warnings. proposal: 90 day public notice, during last 30d emit `X-Deprecation-Warning` on all responses, and automatic 1% canary starting at day 30. thoughts?

priya: that sounds reasonable. 90d avoids breaking SDKs pushed slower. also add a cherrypicked test-suite run for backward-compat per PR (we can gate on eval thresholds).

marc: i'll share traffic numbers by EOD. if pinned traffic >8% we should move to 120d notice or provide a migration runbook for customers.

nina: who owns the customer comms for Dedicated/Private customers? we need targeted emails + console banner.

taylor: customer success + growth should own emails; eng/ops owns console banner and the `X-Deprecation-Warning` implementation. @nina i'll coordinate with CS to draft messaging.

nina: thanks. last: what does rollback look like if v2 causes regressions?

sam: immediate rollback plan: (1) kill v2 routing for unpinned traffic, (2) open a rollback incident with eng-runtime, (3) temporary pin default back to v1 for 24-72h while root cause triaged. we should document exact SLA and playbook.

priya: add automatic metric-based rollback triggers (e.g., eval-regression > 5% OR latency p95 +50ms over baseline for >10min).

marc: agreed. i'll add these thresholds to the rollout config and to runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled task created: rollout-canary-182345 — 1% unpinned traffic to v2 starting 2026-04-02 for 14d. Owner: sam.

nina: perfect. action items: sam -> add canary config + header warning behavior; marc -> traffic numbers + threshold prep; priya -> update regression test suite + gating; taylor -> sync with CS on comms. i'll draft timeline doc and share in #eng-docs.

sam: ping me on the PR when ready, i'll review the rollout flags.

priya: tagging the SDK leads to add deprecation warning parsing and surfaced banner in SDKs.

nina: thanks everyone :thumbsup: any objections to 90/30 plan?

marc: no objections, pending traffic numbers.

sam: 👍

priya: 👍

(tiny note) taylor: CS asked if we can offer optional migration assistance for big Dedicated customers — will escalate if needed.

nina: noted. will add to timeline.

sam: closing the thread — will post PR link when canary config is up.

(End of thread)
